notes: the Imam is named in the words after the chain («عَرَضْتُ هَذِهِ اَلرِّوَايَةَ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اَللَّهِ») and answers: he is the last link (ruling 2)
the report goes on with a second question to Abu Ja'far («وَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ») that has no isnad of its own; not a route of this saying, flagged for ruling
